answer: Every claim climbs the fable of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short.
